up: Retrieve all drug-indication relationships for approved compounds (max_phase = 4) with molecule identifiers and names, ChEBI parent IDs, MeSH identifiers, EFO identifiers, indication labels, and max phase for indication. Include the parent compound's ChEBI ID and pref_name as additional identifiers, filter out entries without a MeSH identifier, and join through molecule_hierarchy to obtain ChEBI parent information. Target is any protein target with assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'.
sql:
WITH drug_indications AS (
  SELECT
    d.molregno,
    d.pref_name AS molecule_name,
    d.chembl_id,
    d.chembl_id AS ChEBI_parent_ID,
    i.mesh_id,
    i.mesh_heading AS MeSH_identifier,
    i.efo_id,
    i.efo_term AS indication_label,
    i.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase,
    ph.pref_name AS ChEBI_parent_name
  FROM drug_indication i
  JOIN molecule_dictionary d ON i.molregno = d.molregno
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.molregno = i.molregno
  LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary ph ON ph.molregno = mh.parent_molregno
  JOIN assays ass ON i.molregno = (SELECT a.molecule_chembl_id FROM activities a WHERE a.assay_id = ass.assay_id)
  WHERE i.max_phase_for_ind = 4
    AND i.mesh_heading IS NOT NULL
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND i.efo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND i.efo_term IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT molregno, molecule_name, ChEBI_parent_ID, ChEBI_parent_name, mesh_id, MeSH_identifier, efo_id, efo_term, max_phase FROM drug_indications;
